title: Every habit you keep is a precommitment
caption: The 6am workout isn't a decision you make at 6am. It's a decision you made the night before, and the night before that. Here's the architecture.

slides.headline: Every habit you keep is a
slides.sub: Made earlier. Bound to be executed later.

slides.body:
The 6am workout was never a decision you made at 6am.

It was a decision you made the night before, when you laid out the clothes. The decision you made the week before, when you booked the trainer. The decision you made three months before, when you agreed to a protocol you couldn't quietly back out of.

slides.title: Decide when emotions are flat
slides.body: The brain that decides at 6am is not the brain that committed at 9pm. Make the decision once, in advance, and make it specific enough that the 6am brain has no room to negotiate.
Not the slip itself — the "I've already failed, might as well…" that follows. Track compliance windows, not streaks.

cards.title: Pre-committed rules
cards.body: Made in calm states. Specific. No judgment calls at decision time.

cards.title: Mechanism-enforced
cards.body: Not just remembered — backed by a system you can't quietly override.

cards.title: Slip-aware metrics
cards.body: Compliance, never perfection. 28-of-30, never the streak.

cards.title: Asymmetric modes
cards.body: Defense automatic. Aggression earned. One-way valves only.

slides.quote: The decision was already made. You're just the courier.

slides.sub: Same architecture Woyuduin runs. Free PDF.
